A week of breakfasts, lunches and dinners based on your blood tests, what you like and your time. With recipes and a shopping list.
Sessions built around your goal, the days you have and what you have to hand. Tick off each exercise and the app keeps count of your week.
Which day and phase you are in, and what usually happens in each. The app takes it into account when reading your resting heart rate and heart rate variability.
One tap per glass, or your bottle if you save it as your measure. See how much you have had against your goal, and the week in bars.
Urine colour in eight drops and your week at a glance, with a concrete idea if one day is darker.
Abstract shapes instead of photos, and what you feel: heartburn, bloating, gas… Over time, the app links it with what you eat.

lista.respuesta: An app to take control of your health. Kuova brings together your lab blood and urine tests, the data from your watch, ring or band and how you feel every day; it explains what they mean and suggests a plan to improve. Then you measure again to see what worked.

lista.pregunta: Is Kuova for preventive health and longevity?
lista.respuesta: Yes, that is what it is built for: knowing your health while you are still well and tracking the signals most linked to more years in good health, such as your fitness, sleep, blood pressure, cholesterol and blood sugar. It does not promise a longer life: it helps you see whether what you do is working. Our guides on [preventive health](/salud-preventiva) and [longevity](/longevidad) explain it (in Spanish).

lista.pregunta: How is Kuova different from Apple Health, Oura or Garmin?
lista.respuesta: Your watch or ring measures how you sleep, how much you move and how your heart beats. Kuova doesn't replace it: it reads that data and adds what no sensor can see, your lab tests, together with how you feel and a plan. We explain it brand by brand in [our comparisons](/comparativas) (in Spanish).

No. Kuova does not diagnose: it gives you clear information to understand your health and to share with a healthcare professional if you wish. Clinical assessment and any medical decision always belong to a professional.
At a lab near you. We're working on letting you collect your sample from home too: we'll let you know as soon as it's available.

lista.pregunta: What does the blood test measure?
lista.respuesta: Markers of metabolism and blood sugar, heart and cholesterol, liver and kidney, thyroid, hormones, iron and vitamins, and inflammation, chosen for your goals. Our [biomarker guides](/biomarcadores) (in Spanish) explain what each one measures and how to read it, with sources.

lista.pregunta: Can I use lab results I already have?
lista.respuesta: Yes. Upload the PDF or a photo and the app extracts the results for you. You review them before saving and they become part of your history.

Watches, rings and bands that sync with Health Connect on Android, for example from Google (Fitbit and Pixel Watch), Samsung, Garmin, Oura, Xiaomi or WHOOP. The iPhone app, connected to Apple Health, is coming soon. We only read the data you allow.

lista.pregunta: Do I need a watch or a ring to use Kuova?
lista.respuesta: No. You can start with your lab tests and your daily log. If you wear a device, Kuova uses its data to give you more context.

lista.pregunta: Why log my diet, exercise or cycle?
lista.respuesta: Because what you do every day changes your blood tests and how you feel. If you log it, Kuova can link it to your results and tell you what works for you and what does not. Our guides on [diet](/alimentacion), [exercise](/ejercicio) and the [menstrual cycle](/ciclo-menstrual) explain why (in Spanish).

An estimate of your biological age using PhenoAge, a published method (Levine and colleagues, 2018) that combines your age with 9 values from an ordinary blood test: whether your body works like that of someone younger or older than you, and what is moving it. It changes with you, test after test. It is an estimate, not a diagnosis. We explain [how it is calculated and how far to trust it](/edad-biologica) (in Spanish).

lista.pregunta: Does the app also teach you about health?
lista.respuesta: Yes. It has short lessons on cycle and fertility, pelvic floor, training and strength, nutrition, sleep, stress and heart health, connected to your data. You can start with [our guides](/aprende) (in Spanish).
It is stored in the European Union with restricted access. We never sell it or use it for advertising, and only the people you authorise can see it.
